items.title: Jordan Addison: 'Progressing really well,' but likely out Week 12
items.text:
Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison is "progressing really well" in his recovery from thumb surgery, though the wide receiver isn't expected to be available Week 12 versus the Falcons, Ben Goessling of the Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drake Maye: Remains on active roster, but out indefinitely
items.text:
For now, Maye -- who suffered a fractured right fibula during a Week 10 loss to the Lions -- remains on the Patriots' 53-man roster rather than injured reserve, with coach Mike Vrabel citing the "balance" the team is hoping to strike with regard to managing its remaining designated to return from IR slots, Mike Reiss of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Still trending positive for Monday night
items.text:
Croskey-Merritt (groin) remains listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Bengals but "is looking good" to return from injured reserve and play, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Juwan Johnson: Extent of hamstring injury remains TBD
items.text:
Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Johnson is still undergoing further medical evaluation after injuring his hamstring during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears, Ross Jackson of WWL-TV reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Seth McGowan: Will miss time with hamstring injury
items.text:
Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that McGowan will miss some time after injuring his hamstring in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Alec Pierce: Not yet shut down for season
items.text:
Head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce continues to rehab his left heel injury, and the wideout hasn't been ruled out for a return from injured reserve before the end of the season, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
